metadata.question: Which region is the fastest growing in recorded music?

response.summary: The fastest growing region in recorded music for 2024 was the Middle East & North Africa (MENA), with a growth rate of 22.8% (Source 1: IFPI Global Music Report 2025, p.6). For 2025, Latin America was the fastest growing region, with a growth rate of 17.1% (Source 5: IFPI Global Music Report 2026, p.15).
